notes: Adds Playnite.Core.Library.PagedLibraryReader, PagedLibraryQuery and PagedLibraryComparer: one SQLite snapshot with ORDER BY, LIMIT and OFFSET in SQL, a required bounded limit, and the stored identity text as the final ascending tie-breaker. Pages load only the requested game graphs, not the full library; an instrumented session seam proves a page of N reads only the N-row window. Text keys use SQLite NOCASE and PagedLibraryComparer is the exact in-memory mirror, including the stored-text identity tie-break; numeric, date and flag orders match LibraryService. Wired via p6-001 (https://github.com/seanburkes/playnite-linux/pull/172): LibraryService list and a blank or null search page through the reader in one SQLite window, so the full-snapshot limitation is removed for that path; a text term, filter or group keeps the p6-001 one-snapshot in-memory path, and a null limit over the 10,000-row cap falls back to it. GameRepository stays unchanged; filters, v10 text search and grouping remain p6-001/p6-011.
